mailbox.prompt: Which mailbox does this watch pull? (e.g. joe@example.com)

watch.note: One watch per mailbox — the mailbox IS the identity, and the watch's slug is what ties its credential binding, its `_raw` slice and its ledgers together. Connector auth is session-level on the pulling machine, per mailbox, and the unit never reads the credential's value: the binding (`llm-wiki-ops credential bind <slug> <name>`) is this machine's per-mailbox switch — until it has one, the claim gate skips the job's harvest here with a `bindings` doctor row, and nothing fails.
